ios.desc:
Match colors. Chain combos. Beat the board.
Score big by pairing complementary colors like red & green or blue & orange.
Simple to play — hard to master.

Tap matching tiles to clear the board, or go for high-score plays by matching complementary color pairs for bonus points. Build streaks, optimize every move, and push your score higher each run.

HOW TO PLAY

• Tap two tiles of the same color to clear them
• Match complementary color pairs for bonus points
• Use Add Rows when you're stuck
• The game ends when you run out of moves — plan carefully

FEATURES

• Endless stages with increasing difficulty
• Daily Challenge — same puzzle for players worldwide
• Game Center leaderboards (All-Time & Daily)
• 65 achievements to unlock
• Hint system to highlight your best move
• Smooth animations, haptics, and satisfying sound
• Full control over sound and feedback

DAILY CHALLENGE

A new challenge drops every day at midnight.
Compete on the same board as players worldwide — can you reach the top?

GAME CENTER

Climb the All-Time leaderboard or dominate the Daily rankings.
Earn achievements for streaks, high scores, and milestones.

NO SUBSCRIPTIONS

Free to play with optional ads.
Remove ads forever with a one-time purchase — no subscriptions, no ongoing charges.
